question: If $\int f(x)dx = F(x) + C$, then $\dfrac{d}{dx}\left[\int f(x)dx\right]$ equals:
explanation:
By the property of indefinite integrals, differentiation reverses integration.

Thus $\dfrac{d}{dx}\left[\int f(x)dx\right] = f(x)$.

Hence the correct answer is $f(x)$.
